description: Defines classes for Bluetooth data record handling, including Buffer, DataRecord, DataRecordBE, and DataRecordLE, with methods for data manipulation, serialization, and byte order management.

classes.name: Buffer
classes.description: A byte buffer class derived from std::basic_string<uint8_t> with a method to convert to hex string.

classes.name: DataRecord
classes.description: A byte-order neutral class for managing a data buffer with read/write operations, supporting serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: DataRecordBE
classes.description: Endian-aware subclass of DataRecord for big-endian data handling.

classes.name: DataRecordLE
classes.description: Endian-aware subclass of DataRecord for little-endian data handling.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts buffer data to a hex string representation.

methods.name: Assign
methods.description: Assigns new data buffer and updates internal state.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the buffer offsets and sizes.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Sets the write offset to a specific position.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write offset by a specified length.

methods.name: Rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the read offset to a specific position.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips forward in the read offset.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fills a section of the buffer with a specific byte value.

methods.name: Push
methods.description: Appends data of various types to the buffer.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Extracts data of various types from the buffer.
